article.title: Looter Giants Disguised as Windmills
article.author: Oscar Daniel Sálomon
article.content: The ideology and methods used to eliminate Argentina's National Institute of Tropical Medicine are exemplary, revealing the intentions of a project of profound social change, disguised in circumstantial justification. The post Looter Giants Disguised as Windmills appeared first on MR Online .
